description: Summarize invoiced revenue for a service-date window, grouped by month or by line item. Amounts in dollars. Canceled invoices are excluded from every figure and reported separately - they keep their full amount on this API, and counting them overstates revenue. Two item modes: "item" is fast and approximate (an invoice's total split evenly across its line names); "item_billed" reads each invoice's detail and sums what each line actually billed - exact, but one extra request per invoice. A month or a quarter is its comfortable size; a whole year runs minutes and can outlast a client's own tool timeout, so for wide windows prefer "item" first and verify the items that matter with a narrower item_billed pass.

group_by.description: Aggregation, default month. item_billed is exact per-line revenue at one detail read per invoice

max_detail_reads.description: item_billed only: cap on per-invoice detail reads, default 500. Invoices past the cap are counted, not silently dropped

max_pages.description: Safety cap on pages walked (100 rows/page), default 20

name: hcp_revenue_summary
